claims.text: La Mirande sits at the foot of the Palais des Papes in Avignon.

findings.quote: quiet beauty at the foot of the Palais des Papes
a peaceful haven in the historic heart of Avignon

claims.text: The hotel is an 18th-century Provencal townhouse.

findings.quote: Staying at La Mirande means experiencing life in an 18th-century Provençal townhouse

claims.text: The Palais des Papes is the world's largest Gothic palace and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

findings.quote: the Palais des Papes, the world's largest Gothic palace and a UNESCO World Heritage Site

claims.text: Each Deluxe Room has its own colour palette, inspired by the fabric chosen for its wall coverings.

findings.quote: Each Deluxe Room has its own distinctive colour palette, inspired by the fabric selected for its wall coverings.

claims.text: The Grand Deluxe Room bathrooms have built-in bathtubs of Arabescato Carrara marble with Edwardian-inspired fittings.

findings.quote: In the bathrooms, "Belle Époque" elegance is expressed through built-in bathtubs crafted from "Arabescato" Carrara marble and Edwardian-inspired fittings

claims.text: The Suite is an 18th-century suite set between the gardens and the Palais des Papes.

findings.quote: An exceptional 18th-century suite, suspended between the gardens and the Palais des Papes

claims.text: Chef Michele Donvito took the helm at La Mirande in 2026.

findings.quote: In 2026, at the age of 32, he took the helm at La Mirande.

claims.text: At the gourmet restaurant, the chef builds his menus as triptychs of three dishes that complement one another.

findings.quote: the chef crafts his menus as triptychs—three dishes that complement one another to tell a story

claims.text: The gourmet restaurant offers a Renaissance dining room or a garden overlooking the Palais des Papes.

findings.quote: the splendor of a Renaissance dining room or the tranquility of a garden overlooking the Palais des Papes

claims.text: Bistrot Pamard serves lunch and dinner in the Louis XV salon beneath Venetian chandeliers, or outdoors facing the Palais des Papes.

findings.quote: perfect for lunch or dinner in the Louis XV salon beneath its Venetian chandeliers, or outdoors facing the Palais des Papes

claims.text: Le Mirage serves white, rose and red wines from regional vineyards by the carafe.

findings.quote: White, rosé and red wines from regional vineyards are served by the carafe.

claims.text: The bar's signature creations showcase Chateauneuf-du-Pape wines alongside spirits from Avignon's Manguin Distillery.

findings.quote: signature creations showcasing the wines of Châteauneuf-du-Pape alongside spirits from Avignon's artisanal Manguin Distillery

claims.text: Each room is adorned with a historic French printed fabric: Indiennes and Toile de Jouy from the workshops of Braquenie, heirs to the Manufacture Royale de Jouy.

findings.quote: Each room is adorned with a historic French printed fabric — Indiennes and Toile de Jouy from the workshops of Braquenié, heirs to the Manufacture Royale de Jouy.

claims.text: La Table Haute is the historic kitchen, with a 19th-century wood-fired stove, where up to twelve guests sit around a large sycamore table and Chef Thomas Longuesserre prepares a single menu for the whole table.

findings.quote: Hidden within the medieval wing of La Mirande lies one of the hotel's greatest treasures: the former kitchen of the Pamard family.

Equipped with a 19th-century wood-fired stove and surrounded by utensils that evoke the great culinary tradition, the historic kitchen welcomes up to twelve guests around its large sycamore wood table.
Here, Chef Thomas Longuesserre prepares a single menu for the entire table

claims.text: The garden, created by gardener Marc Leonetti, mixes box hedges, fruit trees, holm oaks, roses and aromatic herbs, all grown according to the principles of organic farming.

findings.quote: Marc Leonetti, a gardener with a deep love of nature, has created an organised wilderness where box hedges, fruit trees, holm oaks, roses and aromatic herbs grow side by side
all cultivated according to the principles of organic farming

claims.text: The owners cultivate an estate in Sarrians, in the Vaucluse, some twenty kilometres from the hotel, that supplies the kitchens with seasonal produce.

findings.quote: the owners cultivate an estate in Sarrians, in the Vaucluse — some twenty kilometres from the hotel — supplying the kitchens with seasonal produce

claims.text: The owners are a music-loving family, and there have always been concerts at La Mirande.

findings.quote: The owners being a music-loving family, there have always been concerts at La Mirande.

claims.text: The gourmet restaurant is open Thursday through Sunday only, while Bistrot Pamard is open seven days a week.

findings.quote: Open Thursday through Sunday
Open seven days a week, Bistrot Pamard

claims.text: Valet parking and pets both carry an additional charge.

findings.quote: Valet parking (additional charge applies)
Pets welcome (additional charge applies)

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the historic building's traditional room layouts may feel compact.
